title: Cut order-search p95 latency from 1200 ms to 450 ms
problem: Order search on the internal support dashboard timed out under load; support agents waited seconds for every lookup.
action: Designed and built a composite index plus a keyset-paginated query, replaced the ORM-generated search, and added a load test to CI.
result: p95 latency fell from 1200 ms to 450 ms on the production replica, and timeouts disappeared from the dashboard logs.
scope: One service, the support dashboard, 40 support agents
my_role: Owned the fix end to end: profiling, design, rollout
rank_rationale: Solid, measurable performance work owned end to end; expected of a good engineer at three years.
